profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am a graduate of North Carolina A&T State University with bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and in Mathematics. As well as a graduate from the Georgia Institute of Technology with a Masters in Computer Science. I have a strong technical focus on programming languages and computer software. I am interested in working in a fast-paced environment with opportunities to learn and grow.

Additional Skills:
Enthusiastic, personable, ambitious and motivated
Very comfortable with teamwork and collaboration
Comfortable with writing and presentation
Critical thinking and problem solving

I am passionate about pursuing all my short and long term goals in life. I want to make sure that I do all that I can while I am alive. For my long term goals, the one that I would like to do the most is creating my software. Also, I want to become an employee a Computer Networking or Software company. I know these goals sound big; however, my motto is if your dreams do not scare you, they are not big enough!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I work as a Cloud Software enigneer in Azure Security Threat Intelligence Platform. I build, create, and deploy IaaS resources for my customers. I code everyday dealing whether its troubshouting,  or generating new resources. I have similar job of a Devops/ Site reliability Engineer

positions.description:
o Develop Web Scraper using C++ that gathers real-time Ship Information and broadcast it over secure network.

positions.title: Center of Academic Excellence Peer Tutor
positions.locationName: Center of Academic Excellence- NACB Rm 303
positions.description:
Provide individual and small group tutoring to students 
Assist students in improving academic achievement by meeting with them on a regular basis to clarify learning problems and work on study skills. Sessions may be individual, online, group or by appointment.

positions.title: PowerVC Openstack Intern
positions.description:
Utilize OpenStack-Ansible as a tool to deploy OpenStack automatically.
 Deploy POWER processor systems in a mixed CPU architecture OpenStack Cloud
 Collaborated within a team of global developers and participated in weekly scrum meetings

positions.title: Cloud Software Integration Intern
positions.description:
I worked on a total of three projects at Oracle. Where I had responsibilities of the following:
•Creating dashboard and analysis to showcase a Scrum team weekly bug fixes using Oracle Business Intelligence (OBIEE).
•Parameterize Dashboards according to which week bugs were fixed, using tables and pivot graphs.
•Use JDeveloper to connect with WSRPs to check for CSRF attacks on existing Portlets
•Worked with Linux commands and VC Software on a VNC Viewer
•Develop and Implement UI interfaces using JDeveloper

positions.title: IT Engineer Intern
positions.description: I work on two projects during my internship, one was under the Connected IT Service on the Software Supply Chain team. I worked on the Software Licensing Tool (SLT), where I pair programmed the Test Driven Development tab for the Software Infrastructure Team and to better handle all the automated testing needed when on SLT. Secondly, I worked on the End of Summer Showcase team where was able to use my people skills and event planning.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Being visible and accessible to residents. Assist in residents academic and maintenance concerns. Build community among residents by enforcing student’s code of conduct. Engage residents in diverse programs held in the Residence Hall lobby.

positions.title: Talent-21 Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked under Dr. Clemence a Mathematics Professor at North Carolina A&T State University. I did research on STDs, specifically HIV and Syphilis, and if you were to contract one later down the line you will be more prone to the other. I used differential equations and other mathematical resources for this research.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: basic customer service, cleaning duties, seating arrangements, and selling food and tickets. Using basic customer service, my duties were to ensure customer satisfaction by being knowledgeable about movies and their ratings as well as assist with any customer needs. My duties for cleaning included; sweeping floors, wiping down counters, and basic bathroom cleanup procedures. With elderly and handicapped customers, my job was to assist with seating arrangements that would allow them to have a comfortable and enjoyable movie experience. By selling food and tickets, it was my job to know what products to recommend to our customers.

positions.title: IT Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked on two projects during my internship, one Customer Experience Time zone Analysis where I identify patterns in case volume and closure rates relative to user location/time zone. Second Operations Dashboard for NetSpace, where I collate various information/content and develop a dashboard for operational metrics using Java.

educations.schoolName: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

honors.title: 1st Place Black Enterprise Hackathon (2016)
honors.description: In 24 hours, my team and I created the winning iOS application using four required APIs. Working on this team, I learned how to implement Stripe API and how to stimulate my creativity in a time crunching environment.
